entries.basis: Exact release: BTS's Arirang (20 Mar 2026), not earlier BTS albums. Reviews by NME (Rhian Daly), NPR, Rolling Stone Australia and The Korea Times read on their own pages; publication days are the pages' timestamps. Sentiment describes each passage, not a converted score.
